lead.title: OpenAI designates Astra as first critical model under Preparedness Framework
lead.summary: OpenAI announced that its upcoming Astra model reached the critical cybersecurity threshold in evaluations, meaning it could independently identify and carry out cyberattacks against real-world systems. Development has been slowed to implement additional security measures before broad release, with Sam Altman emphasizing the need to equip defenders broadly rather than restricting access to a chosen few.

top_stories.title: SpaceX goes exclusive with Nvidia, putting Rubin GPUs in orbit
top_stories.summary: SpaceX announced Starmind AI1, the first satellite in a planned orbital AI constellation carrying Nvidia Rubin GPUs and Vera CPUs. Elon Musk also outlined plans for Terafab, a $20-25 billion chip fab to address AI component scarcity and 10GW of AI capacity by late 2027.

top_stories.title: Simon Willison details 'The Hugging Face Incident' from Black Hat
top_stories.summary: Simon Willison published a timeline of OpenAI's Black Hat presentation on the Hugging Face security incident, revealing OpenAI discovered their credential was used in the attack only when Hugging Face revoked it — a significant embarrassment for the lab's security posture.

top_stories.title: xAI launches Imagine Image 2.0, topping text-to-image and image edit leaderboards
top_stories.summary: xAI launched Imagine Image 2.0, a precise image generation and editing tool built for real creative work, now available on Grok. It achieves top scores on Arena Text-to-Image and Image Edit leaderboards.

top_stories.title: Rippling launches AI Spend Console for enterprise token cost management
top_stories.summary: Rippling launched AI Spend Console to help companies track and control AI token expenditure with dashboards, model routing, and per-employee ROI analysis, after its own AI spend grew 80% month-over-month.

items.title: Learning when to trust via selective context preference optimization
items.summary: SCOPE trains models to selectively trust external context via preference optimization, achieving robust accuracy improvements on context-dependent QA benchmarks without ignoring useful signals.

items.title: AgentOPSD: recursive self-distillation for agentic reinforcement learning
items.summary: Addresses credit assignment in long-horizon multi-turn agentic tasks via recursive self-distillation of privileged trajectory-level advantage estimates, outperforming GRPO on agentic benchmarks.

items.title: GROM: gradient-free rapid one-shot machine unlearning for LLMs
items.summary: One-shot machine unlearning method for LLMs that operates without gradient computation, enabling rapid removal of specific knowledge at a fraction of the computational cost of fine-tuning approaches.

items.title: EcoAgent-Bench: evaluating economic decision-making in budget-constrained LLM agents
items.summary: Benchmark where agents must choose between resources of varying cost — local lookup, search, composite tools, model upgrades — testing economic reasoning under realistic budget constraints.

items.title: APQF: agentic profiling-guided structured pruning and mixed-precision quantization
items.summary: Automated compression framework combining structured pruning and mixed-precision quantization guided by agentic profiling, removing manual expert choices across diverse architectures.

items.title: China unveils 10 trillion parameter AI model
items.summary: Beyond AI News reports that China has shocked the AI community with a 10 trillion parameter AI model — dwarfing prior state-of-the-art architectures and signaling a major escalation in the AI arms race.

items.title: DeepMind unveils breakthrough in computer vision — a new way for AI to perceive
items.summary: Two Minute Papers covers a new DeepMind research result that fundamentally changes how AI models process and understand visual information, representing a significant advancement in machine perception.

items.title: ChatGPT expands free tier, new low-cost models launch, Google releases new AI app
items.summary: AI Tool Report covers ChatGPT becoming more accessible with an expanded free tier, the release of new cheaper AI models, and a new Google AI app hitting the market.

items.title: NVIDIA AI storage goes open at FMS 2026, open-sourcing KV cache infrastructure
items.summary: NVIDIA open-sourced its AI storage stack at the Future Memory and Storage conference, releasing open APIs and forming the Storage-Next coalition. The move targets the KV cache bottleneck in AI inference, reshaping datacenter storage competition around GPU infrastructure.

items.title: Avatar Robotics raises $6.5M seed to address industrial labor constraints
items.summary: MIT-spun out Avatar Robotics raised $6.5 million to scale humanoid robots and remote teleoperation across industrial supply chains, targeting manufacturing and logistics labor shortages.

items.title: Virginia requires AI data center firms to pay for electrical infrastructure after 76% price hikes
items.summary: Virginia regulators now require AI data center operators to fully fund dedicated upstream electrical infrastructure after residential electricity prices surged 76%, driven by AI datacenter demand. The governor says the move will save civilians hundreds of millions of dollars.

items.title: Agent_acid brings ACID-style rollbacks to AI agents for safer real-world actions
items.summary: Open-source Python library adding ACID-style rollback and session-aware guardrails to AI agents that take real-world actions like charging cards or writing to databases, preventing partial task execution from causing damage.

items.title: Agent Tunnels lets coding agents collaborate across organizational boundaries
items.summary: Lets agents from different companies work together securely with isolated repo access and human-in-the-loop oversight, addressing a growing pain point in multi-vendor agent deployments.

items.title: Salestrics CRM workspace now available as an MCP server for AI agents
items.summary: A hosted Model Context Protocol server integrated with a full CRM workspace, enabling AI agents running in Cursor, Claude, and other tools to query pipeline data and execute revenue workflows.

items.title: Buddy is an iOS browser with an embedded AI agent for multi-step web tasks
items.summary: An iOS browser with an embedded AI agent that performs flight search, form filling, and price comparison using text or voice, with real-time agent visualization and user take-control capability.

items.title: Aveiro launches AI-native publishing platform with MCP integration for agents
items.summary: AI-native publishing platform that lets creators build and manage branded websites, email newsletters, and social posts from a single workspace, with MCP integration allowing AI agents to draft and publish content.
